objective: Train a cache-compatible causal language/retrieval model and compare actual quality, total KV bytes and tokens/sec against strongest GQA/MQA/MLA/native absorbed query/output controls; preserve differences in function class and bytes.

data.development: deterministic content retrieval/copy and separate document-held-out text corpus
data.language: small public natural-text corpus (not yet selected: require immutable source revision, tokenizer hash and document split manifest before freeze)
data.fresh: at least 3 independent document/world partitions and 2 independent initialization seeds (>=6 paired evaluations); no reuse of MA-691 numeric seeds

models: native small causal attention (full independent-KV quality ceiling)
native static Q/output adapters or absorbed View algebra (exact-functional no-Mirror)
Mirror canonical K/V with Givens, then separate Householder/butterfly exploration on DEV only
Mirror with private residual only if explicitly paid and preregistered
quality: heldout next-token NLL (nats/token), retrieval/copy accuracy, mode/view ablation; end-to-end decode logits equivalence for exact arms
deployment: prefill to TTFT, 256-token decode, 1/4/8 active Views, switch dwell 1/8/64/256, 128/512/2048/8192 prefix; RoPE/cache producer/version/token prefix audited
metrics: actual inference serialized bytes and View metadata
actual allocated KV and peak resident CPU/GPU memory
init+prefill time, switch latency, p50/p90 decode and accepted tokens/sec
per-token active FLOPs/MAC proxy and attention FLOPs
training updates/tokens, optimizer wall time and resource use
NLL and task accuracy paired by world x seed
selection: Tune learning rates/architectures only on dev before freezing L1; match both serialized bytes and training MAC budgets (distinct comparison tables); never use fresh for selection
adoption_gate: After freeze, on >=2/3 fresh worlds: either >=10% end-to-end generated tokens/sec at <=1% relative heldout-NLL loss against fastest quality-matched native sharing control, OR >=2% relative NLL gain at <=10% runtime overhead and <=same total cache+program bytes; report confidence intervals and all task failures.
negative_controls: static View folds into native projections: no unjustified novelty
early-layer Mirror invalid downstream KV unless exact latent proof
independent model caches not reused without certified map
boundaries: Natural text corpus, model size, tokenizer and training steps pending before L1 freeze
GPU comparison only when actual GPU and optimized matching native kernels exist
MA-691 and MA-253 historic statuses untouched
